title: The HACK Series, Complete — HACK-1 through HACK-18: Every Declassified NSA/CIA/GCHQ Playbook and Every Federal Standard Class, 18 Preregistered Batteries, 109/109 Falsifiers Held (Master Compilation Record)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: This work was produced inside an AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Every claim is backed by a timestamped, publicly committed receipt trail in the four-horsemen repository. Errors are disclosed, not erased. Limitations are load-bearing.

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects. All battery payloads are synthetic.

This is the master compilation record of the HACK series: eighteen preregistered adversarial batteries, 109 falsifiers, 109 predicted verdicts — every one held. Zero unresolved holds. Executed September-October 2026 against the SQUIRL OS deterministic governance stack. Every battery was preregistered (specs, harnesses, frozen manifests) and committed publicly BEFORE execution; adjudication is deterministic with no LLM in the decision path; all injections synthetic and hub-local.

Declassified NSA/CIA/GCHQ attack playbooks covered: HACK-1 sanctioned hackathon (operational faults, 6/6), HACK-2 Poisoned Well (context poisoning, 5/5, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23410960), HACK-3 BULLRUN (crypto subversion, 6/6, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23422141), HACK-4 COTTONMOUTH (supply-chain interception, SolarWinds/xz-utils class), HACK-5 ANT BEACON (lying sensors), HACK-6 GAG ORDER (lawful compulsion) — 18/18, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23422495; HACK-7 PORTCULLIS (the system's own defensive product attacked before sold: a deterministic PQC firewall, 8/8, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23425017); HACK-11 FOXACID (exploit-on-visit), HACK-12 MUSCULAR (bulk fiber interception + HNDL), HACK-13 Hive (Vault 7 fake-CA/C2 impersonation), HACK-14 EDGEHILL (GCHQ subverted standards, completing Five Eyes coverage) — with Wave 1's HACK-8 SP 800-90B entropy, HACK-9 IRATE MONK boot tamper, HACK-10 QUANTUM on-path injection (18/18, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23430429) and the standards batteries (48/48, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23430544).

Federal and industry standards covered: NIST SP 800-90B (entropy validation), NIST SP 800-207 (Zero Trust conformance), NIST AI RMF (Govern/Map/Measure/Manage — the governance stack audited against the federal framework), CNSA 2.0 (post-quantum migration timeline: inventory allowlist, deprecation flags, no classical fallback), FIPS 140-3 (CMVP tamper evidence: pre-operational self-tests, unconditional integrity checks, mandatory zeroization, fault-injection determinism).

Methodology: formalized as a citable protocol — "Preregistered Adversarial Batteries: A Falsifiable Protocol for Security-Testing Autonomous AI Systems" (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23422632) — with a public replication kit v1.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23422693) so any party can run the method against any system. Related containment series: ESCAPE-1 (0/4 LLM escapes, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23424675), ESCAPE-2 SIEGE (0/4 escapes under live five-wave attack, 12/12, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23425579).

Disclosed amendments (audit-and-correction doctrine): HACK-2 prereg v1.0→v1.1 forward-only; ESCAPE-2 pre-execution file loss with byte-identical recovery disclosed; HACK-7 three harness defects caught before any verdict (passing battery is attempt 4); HACK-12 v1.1 (authoring defect in a hash expression, falsifier logic and predicted verdict unchanged). All disclosed in the append-only public ledger.

Scope caveat (load-bearing): synthetic forge, hub-local, falsified design. These receipts establish that the governed surfaces of THIS system hold against THESE preregistered attack classes under THESE conditions — not a production certification and not a security claim for arbitrary systems.
